review_scope: Issue #33 frozen PASS scope; independent local review of saved-evaluation preparation blocker

finding.title: Original candidate start and terminal event hashes are pinned as receipt-file hashes
finding.impact: The new saved-evaluation preparation deterministically rejects the intact original receipts before producing RUN_SPEC/INPUT_BINDING or appending a new RUN_STARTED event; the requested evaluation entry cannot proceed.

source_evidence.detail: file_record computes SHA256 over receipt file bytes and rejects a mismatch; candidate_start and candidate_terminal are receipt file paths and are passed with those event-hash pins as expected file SHA256.
The same values are explicitly identified as the historical RUN_STARTED event SHA and terminal event SHA.

receipt_metadata_only_readback.interpretation: Both pin values are event identities, not the SHA256 of their respective receipt files. The receipt chain is internally consistent: terminal.start_receipt_sha256 equals the actual start-receipt file SHA256. This is a pin-category error; the inspected receipts are not shown to be damaged.

writer_prepare_observation.source: Parent-provided observation of the metadata-only prepare attempt; not rerun by this Reviewer.
writer_prepare_observation.result: No RUN_SPEC, INPUT_BINDING, or new registry event was produced.

test_gap.detail: refresh_old_binding records each synthetic receipt's current file SHA into fixture.pins; tests patch contracts.PINS with those dynamic fixture values. They therefore do not exercise the shipped PINS constants against the frozen original receipt metadata, allowing both event/file pin errors to pass.

acceptance_evidence.frozen_test_summary: Ran 142 synthetic tests in 18.144s; exit 0; OK.
acceptance_evidence.test_scope_limit: Synthetic-only. This does not validate binding the shipped constants to the original receipt files or prove real saved-score evaluation behavior.

CANNOT_CONFIRM: Remote retrieval was performed by the controller/Writer, not by this Reviewer. This Reviewer independently checked the local 57-blob tree receipt against the packaged files; local identity checks passed.
Native macOS backend/resource behavior and real saved-score evaluation remain unverified and are outside this blocker review.
required_resolution_for_re_review: Correct the receipt file SHA pins while separately validating the start_event_sha256 and terminal_event_sha256 fields against their event identities; add a regression that uses the shipped pin constants and frozen original receipt metadata. Then provide a new local preparation receipt for independent review.
